discovered_urls.title: Showboat
discovered_urls.reason: Willison's CLI tool for documenting agentic manual testing workflows. Three commands: showboat note (Markdown commentary), showboat exec (records commands with actual output — prevents agent fabrication of results), showboat image (screenshots). Directly relevant to our E2E testing gate (Rule #2). Novel pattern: tests and documentation produced simultaneously. 14 tagged posts on simonwillison.net.

discovered_urls.title: Rodney
discovered_urls.reason: Willison's CDP-based browser automation CLI purpose-built for coding agents. Install via uvx (zero-config). Provides screenshot, JS execution, scrolling, clicking, typing, accessibility tree. uvx --help pattern gives agents complete usage docs inline. Lightweight alternative to full Playwright for agent browser automation. 4 tagged posts on simonwillison.net.
